description: Install Nim, create project structure, and verify the toolchain works. Create a new git branch feat/phase-1-parser from the current branch.
steps: Install Nim stable via choosenim: curl https://nim-lang.org/choosenim/init.sh -sSf | sh (non-interactive, add to PATH)
Create doot.nimble file at /projects/sandbox/Doot/doot.nimble with: name='doot', version='0.1.0', author, description, license, srcDir='src', bin=@['doot'], backend='c', requires 'nim >= 2.0.0'
Create directory structure: src/, src/doot/, tests/, examples/blog/, examples/blog/views/layouts/, examples/blog/views/posts/
Create a minimal src/doot.nim entry point that imports the parser module (placeholder)
Create a minimal src/doot/lexer.nim with a placeholder proc
Create a minimal src/doot/parser.nim with a placeholder proc
Create a minimal src/doot/ast.nim with placeholder types
Run 'nimble build' to verify the project compiles
Create a minimal tests/test_lexer.nim using unittest that has one passing test
Add a 'task test' to doot.nimble that runs the test files, then run 'nimble test' to verify tests pass
acceptance_criteria: Git branch feat/phase-1-parser exists and is checked out
Directory structure exists: src/doot/, tests/, examples/blog/
verification: Run 'nimble build' and confirm exit code 0
Run 'nimble test' and confirm exit code 0
